input.source:
---- MODULE WideOrdered ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
VARIABLE x
Init == x=0
Next == IF x=0 THEN x' \in 1..64 ELSE IF x=1 THEN x'=65 ELSE IF x=2 THEN x'=Head(<<>>) ELSE x'=x
Safe == x<=64
====
input.config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

input.name: wide-function-fault
input.source:
---- MODULE FunctionCube ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE nodes
Init == nodes = [node \in 1..N |-> 0]
Next == \E node \in 1..N: nodes' = [nodes EXCEPT ![node] = 1-@]
Safe == nodes \in [1..N -> 0..1] /\ Cardinality({node \in 1..N: nodes[node]=1})<6
====
input.config:
CONSTANT N=12
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
